errors.text_span: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die prozentuale Metallproduktion in Deutschland und der EU für die Jahre 2021, 2022 und 2023.
errors.evidence: The chart represents the percentage of Russian imports of industrial raw materials (Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel) in Germany and the EU, not the percentage of metal production.

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse stellt den Prozentsatz der Metallproduktion dar, mit Werten von 0 bis 30 und einem logarithmischen Maßstab.
errors.evidence: The vertical axis represents percentages of Russian imports, not metal production, and the scale is linear, not logarithmic.

errors.text_span: Die dunkelblauen Balken die Daten für 2021 darstellen, die hellblauen Balken die Daten für 2022 und die hellgelben Balken die Daten für 2023.
errors.evidence: The colors are blue for 2021, violet for 2022, and gray for 2023, not dark blue, light blue, and yellow.

errors.text_span: Für Aluminium beträgt der zugeordnete Balkenwert 2021 3,6 %, 2022 5,1 % und 2023 4,4 %.
errors.evidence: The values for Aluminium in Germany are 3.6% (2021), 2.7% (2022), and 1.0% (2023), not 3.6%, 5.1%, and 4.4%.

errors.text_span: Für Kupfer beträgt der zugeordnete Balkenwert 2021 2,7 %, 2022 1,8 % und 2023 1,3 %.
errors.evidence: The values for Kupfer in Germany are 8.3% (2021), 11.3% (2022), and 2.2% (2023), not 2.7%, 1.8%, and 1.3%.

errors.text_span: Der zugeordnete Balkenwert für Nickel beträgt 2021 11,3 %, 2022 11,4 % und 2023 8,3 %.
errors.evidence: The values for Nickel in Germany are 25.1% (2021), 24.7% (2022), and 11.4% (2023), not 11.3%, 11.4%, and 8.3%.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart shows the percentage of Russian imports of industrial raw materials in Germany and the EU.
The description does not mention that the vertical axis is labeled as '%' and scaled from 0 to 30 with ticks every 5 units.
The description does not mention that the chart consists of two separate bar charts, one for Germany and one for the EU.
The description does not mention the grouping of bars by year and the specific order of colors: blue for 2021, violet for 2022, and gray for 2023.
The description does not mention the specific values for the EU: Aluminium (3.2%, 2.8%, 1.7%), Kupfer (4.4%, 5.1%, 1.3%), and Nickel (24.3%, 23.3%, 14.6%).
